title: DC Universe Christmas (DC Comics, 2000) Hardcover – Holiday Comic Anthology
descriptionText:
DC Universe Christmas (DC Comics, 2000) Hardcover – Holiday Comic Anthology
Condition: Excellent / Like New
🎄 Description:
Celebrate the holidays with the DC Universe’s greatest heroes and villains!
This festive hardcover collection brings together classic and modern Christmas tales featuring Superman, Batman, Wonder Woman, The Flash, Green Lantern, the Teen Titans, Captain Marvel (Shazam!), and even Darkseid!
Packed with heartwarming, hilarious, and action-filled stories, DC Universe Christmas is a perfect gift or collectible for comic fans of all ages — a nostalgic reminder that even superheroes need a little holiday cheer.
📚 Includes Stories From:
Batman in “Wanted: Santa Claus — Dead or Alive!” by Denny O’Neil and Frank Miller
Wonder Woman in “The Story of Fir Balsam” (1943) by William Moulton Marston and H.G. Peter
Superman in “The Gift” by Dan Jurgens and Brett Breeding
The Flash in “Present Tense” by Mark Waid and Brian Augustyn
Teen Titans in “A Swingin’ Christmas Carol!”
Robin in “Alone for the Holidays” by Chuck Dixon
Batman, Harley Quinn, & Poison Ivy in “The Harley and the Ivy” by Paul Dini
Impulse in “No, Bart, There is No Santa Claus” by Mark Waid & Devin Grayson
Darkseid in “Present Tense” by Ty Templeton
Superman’s Christmas Adventure (1940) by Jerry Siegel & Jack Burnley
…and many more!
🎨 Creators Featured:
Denny O’Neil, Frank Miller, Paul Dini, Mark Waid, Dan Jurgens, Chuck Dixon, William Moulton Marston, H.G. Peter, and others
📖 Book Details:
Publisher: DC Comics
Publication Year: 2000
ISBN: 1-56389-640-0
Format: Hardcover (no dust jacket as issued)
Pages: 160
Cover Design & Art: Ty Templeton
Genre: Superhero, Holiday, Anthology
📸 Condition Notes:
Excellent condition – clean and bright cover with vivid colors
Tight binding and crisp pages
No writing, tears, or spine damage
Minimal shelf wear on corners (see photos for details)
